nativeCli.title: Native CLI experts
nativeCli.intro: Use an already authenticated CLI as an expert’s model engine while retaining Octop conversations, roles, teams, tools and approvals. Existing execution defaults stay unchanged.
nativeCli.modelHelp: Empty uses the CLI default. A value must be a model config option supported by that CLI.
nativeCli.modeHelp: Use an exact mode ID offered by the CLI. Unsupported IDs fail. Empty preserves the CLI default; global CLI settings are not changed.
nativeCli.permissionBoundary: Octop tools still run through this platform’s tool nodes and approvals. CLI builtin operations depend on its permission mode and OS sandbox. Builtin actions without permission events cannot be guaranteed to pass Octop review; choose a suitable restricted mode.
nativeCli.launcherVersion: This is the npm/npx launcher version, not proof that its CLI package is installed, authenticated or verified. Inspection installs nothing.
nativeCli.inspectionHelp: Only known CLI --version commands run. No model prompt or login token is read or copied.
nativeCli.closeConfirm: Close this CLI connection and forget its resume mapping? Octop history and project files are preserved.
nativeCli.managedIntro: Managed versions install only inside this account’s OCTOP_HOME, checking pinned releases/dependency locks, SHA256 or npm SHA512 SRI and licenses. System CLIs, global Node/npm packages and login data are preserved. Required Node runtimes are private and verified; global PATH is unchanged. Installation never starts vendor CLIs or lifecycle scripts; a controlled Node codec may decode compressed data. Updates, activation and rollback require explicit action.
nativeCli.activateConfirm: Point this account’s dedicated managed runner at this verified version? Other runners and logins are preserved. Active expert work blocks the switch.
nativeCli.chooseManagedRunner: Managed runner registered. Choose it above and save the expert’s execution settings before use.
nativeCli.rollbackConfirm: Return to the previous executable version? No database, workspace or CLI login is restored.
nativeCli.unsupportedPlatform: No reviewed build of this package is available for this platform.
nativeCli.adminOnly: Only administrators can configure host CLIs and managed installs. This view is read-only.

errors.not_configured: Native CLI execution is not enabled for this expert.
errors.runner_disabled: The selected CLI runner is disabled.
errors.runner_missing: CLI executable not found. Install it and log in first.
errors.protocol_failed: CLI protocol connection failed. Check runner version and settings.
errors.authentication_required: CLI login or an authenticated Octop caller is required.
errors.actor_required: Native CLI requires the expert owner’s authenticated identity.
errors.thread_not_owned: This conversation does not belong to the current account and expert.
errors.cwd_changed: This native CLI session is bound to another project. Close its CLI connection before retrying.
errors.cwd_unavailable: Native CLI requires an accessible local project or folder.
errors.busy: This CLI session is running or awaiting approval.
errors.tool_result_missing: A pending CLI tool result is missing. Stopped to avoid replaying actions.
errors.permission_rejected: CLI operation was not approved and was not reported as successful.
errors.mode_unavailable: The CLI does not offer the selected permission mode; restrictions were not downgraded.
errors.model_unavailable: The CLI does not offer the selected model option.
errors.session_closed: CLI session closed. Send the current request again.
errors.cli_failed: CLI execution failed. Check local CLI status; sensitive raw errors are not echoed.
errors.async_required: This CLI model requires its running async executor.
errors.interrupted: The previous CLI run was interrupted with uncertain action state. Review it, close this CLI session, and send a new request; actions are not replayed automatically.
errors.input_too_large: CLI input exceeded the limit. Reduce the current input first.
errors.admin_required: Native CLI uses host CLI login profiles. Only the administrator who owns this individual expert may enable or run it.
errors.managed_download_failed: Managed download failed; existing CLIs were not replaced.
errors.managed_integrity: Package size, SHA256 or license check failed; this version was not activated.
errors.managed_unsafe_archive: Archive has unsafe paths, links or oversized contents and was rejected.
errors.managed_missing_binary: Archive did not contain exactly one expected CLI executable.
errors.managed_unsupported_platform: This reviewed version does not support this platform.
errors.managed_busy: This account already has an installation in progress for this package.
errors.managed_modified: Installed managed files changed; this operation did not overwrite them.
errors.managed_install_failed: Managed installation failed; existing runners and login data are preserved.
errors.managed_not_installed: Install and verify this version first.
errors.managed_runner_changed: The managed runner was manually modified; activation did not overwrite its settings.
errors.managed_no_previous: No previously activated version is available for rollback.
errors.reuse_private_target: Native CLI settings can only be reused on this account’s private individual experts.
errors.unsupported_media: This CLI did not advertise the required image/audio/embedded-resource capability, or the attachment format cannot be forwarded. Choose a supported CLI/model or upload again; the attachment was not silently ignored.

nativeCli.capabilitiesHelp: Save execution settings, then read explicitly. Opens and closes a protocol session without a model prompt, tools or startup permission grants. Advertised choices are shown and validated again at execution.

picker.label: CLI model for this conversation
picker.hint: Applies when the next message is sent. Does not change other conversations, the runner or its permission mode.
picker.failed: Cannot read the authorized CLI model list. Open native CLI settings and detect capabilities first.

managedNotes.opencode: Official standalone executable, without Node. Runs through ACP; automatic updates are disabled only for this runner.
managedNotes.pi: Official Pi + MIT community ACP adapter + private Node. The current community adapter does not connect Octop MCP tools to Pi. Pi conversations work, but this is not full Octop tool integration. Adapter, licenses and dependencies are pinned.
managedNotes.claude: Public Apache-2.0 ACP adapter, official Claude Agent SDK and account-isolated Node. Anthropic commercial terms apply to the SDK/service. The official CLI manages login and usage.
managedNotes.cline: Standalone Cline executable from the official npm platform package, running with --acp. Installation does not run npm or postinstall.
managedNotes.grok: Official xAI platform package. Only a verified private Node built-in codec unpacks Brotli; then the standalone Grok executable runs with --no-auto-update. No npm lifecycle scripts run.
managedNotes.gemini: Pinned official npm release and platform dependencies with account-isolated Node. Host Node/npm configuration is not read and dependency lifecycle scripts are not run. Official login, authorization and compatibility requirements still apply.
managedNotes.cursor: Fixed direct Cursor distribution, retaining its bundled Node. Uses an account-specific configuration directory and static update channel, without copying or modifying host configuration/login. This profile may require separate official login. Windows uses the Node entry directly, without command scripts.

nativeCli.managedExternal: Muse is an OpenBot-hosted service, not a standalone CLI available from a public distribution. Its private source, accounts and hosting backend are not included. Integration requires an official interface and authorization from the operator.
